context: Patronage: the Corwin lobby, with a box of fans.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Fans. For the hot floors. From the owner. From me.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: Fans are nice, Mr. Varelas. Wiring is nicer. Leases are nicest.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: One thing at a time, Mrs. Pruitt.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: That's what we've been saying for eighteen years.
